finding: The non-remainder start offset is computed with remainder*(remainder+1)/2 rather than the number of rows assigned to the remainder ranks. At n=513, 128 ranks, rank 0 owns five rows but rank 1 starts at row 1 instead of row 5; subsequent ranks are likewise shifted. Gather offsets use correct prefix counts, so the duplicated/shifted source rows are reconstructed in incorrect global positions. Pivot ownership is also inconsistent with these starts.
observed_failure: The 128-rank check produces nonzero diagonal entries, reports diagonal [5,5] invalid, and exits 1. The paired r5 check passes in 19.87 seconds.
interpretation: Pre-existing remainder-partition numerical defect, not scheduling interference. The timing correction changes only duration aggregation. Retain failure without retry.
investigation: Static source inspection, original/effective diff and retained numerical failure; no new program execution.
